'''FC Algeti''' ({{lang-ka|საფეხბურთო კლუბი ალგეთი}}) is a Georgian municipal [[football (soccer)|football]] club from [[Marneuli]], competing in [[Liga 4 (Georgia)|Liga 4]], the fourth tier of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]].

The club plays their home matches at the Marneuli central stadium. 

The name comes from the [[Algeti River|Algeti]] river."}}
